title: Validate a payment request body
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Each field is checked in the order missing, type, range or format, booleans are excluded from amount, null metadata is a type error, and the codes come back sorted and unique.
isinstance(True, int) holds in Python, so an otherwise valid body with "amount": true returns [] instead of ["amount_type"], though the brief says booleans are amount_type.
Table-driven checks with a sentinel for absent fields produce exactly the specified codes, with type(value) is not int keeping booleans and floats out of amount.
It treats "metadata": null as absent and returns [] for an otherwise valid body, where the brief requires ["metadata_type"], and it asks the grader to skip the brief.
